source_document_header: 2026-27 NBA REGULAR SEASON SCHEDULE AS OF AUGUST 13, 2026 | SUBJECT TO CHANGE
extraction_tool: python3 scripts/build_load_snapshot.py -- computed by engine.travel.compute_load from the official schedule rows and the sourced arena table

method.rest_days: elapsed time between the tip of the team's previous game in the window and this one, in days; blank for a team's first game in the window
method.games_in_next_four_days: games by the same team with tips in [this tip, this tip + 4 days]
method.travel_miles: great-circle distance from the venue of the team's previous game to the venue of this one; blank when either venue is not asserted by the source
method.away_home_basis: asserted only where the schedule PDF prints an 'at' token, or where an official 05:00 PM injury report prints a matchup code (AWAY@HOME) for the same game. The printed order is never used to infer the basis.

coverage.travel_note: A row still has no travel value when the schedule row printed no venue, no official injury report had yet asserted one, or the team's previous game falls outside the look-back window. Those cases are named per row in 'notes'.
